# TAVAAZO

> TAVAAZO is the flagship consumer food brand of MJ Agro Group, offering authentic Pakistani and South Asian recipe mixes, spices, culinary pastes and cooking essentials for modern kitchens across Europe and the United Kingdom.

## Official sources
- Website: https://trade.mjagrogroup.com/
- Product catalogue: https://trade.mjagrogroup.com/TAVAAZO-Product-Catalogue-2026.pdf
- Parent company: https://mjagrogroup.com/
- B2B email: info@mjagrogroup.com
- WhatsApp — EU, UK, Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein and Switzerland: +33 7 58 49 63 34
- WhatsApp — rest of world: +92 335 0343465

## Product range
TAVAAZO currently presents 31 products in seven categories:
- Biryani and pulao recipe mixes
- BBQ and tandoori masalas
- Heritage and slow-cook recipe mixes
- Kabab, korma and seafood blends
- Vegetarian, snack and chaat seasonings
- Basic spices and fried onion
- Fresh culinary pastes

## Pakistani recipes
TAVAAZO publishes step-by-step cooking guides with timings, ingredients and direct links to the relevant TAVAAZO products:
- Recipes hub: https://trade.mjagrogroup.com/recipes
- Pakistani Chicken Biryani: https://trade.mjagrogroup.com/recipes/chicken-biryani

- Pakistani Beef Nihari: https://trade.mjagrogroup.com/recipes/pakistani-nihari

## European distribution enquiries
Retailers, wholesalers, distributors, HORECA suppliers and retail chains can use the Partner with us form on the official website or email info@mjagrogroup.com for product information, documents, availability and market-specific quotations.
